source: resources.assets of Steam build 25319640 (original file, not an installed localized copy)
method: Localized textures are embedded into resources.assets; the original .resS stays unchanged. Common UI images: generated lettering composited onto the original artwork. Tutorial images, the WIN atlas and floor badges: native bitmap editing and typesetting with original dimensions and alpha. Each texture records its own method below.
external_application_policy: Lovense application screenshots retain real English controls exactly. No Russian overlays, glosses or extra explanations. Translate only game-owned UI.
intentionally_preserved: Roman tier numerals I/II/III and EX
External Lovense English controls (no added explanations)
Lovense device model names / addresses / ports
Tomoki sample player name; HE/NE/BE ending codes
